svg.aria-label: The designed evals flow. A question enters the Host App over MCP or its web UI and reaches the engine's catalogue. The engine runs cells against the host's object under test and reads, writes, traces and calls models only through ports the host fills, each with an adapter backed by the host's own system or a 3tears module. analysis_generate freezes the evidence, the analyst and editor write and review the report, and the host serves the stored page. A gap the analyst reports becomes an issue, then a change to 3tears built outside any run.

svg.text: OUTSIDE ANY RUN · THE GAP LOOP AND DEVELOPMENT

g.text: an agent or Claude client on MCP, or a person in the web UI
anything behind the engine's CandidateKind seam:
the host's own kinds: a persona or chat agent,
kinds the engine ships: an eval judge, a report
writer, any callable: a pipeline, a tool-using
agent, an agent acting on a world
over_budget: the last reviewed draft, if any
failed: nothing stored; tally and sessions kept
